flow.name: Process-GL-Integration-Flow
flow.description: Main processing pipeline for GL CSV integration. Accepts parsed CSV records, applies rules, transforms, and submits to SKY API.

sub-flow.name: Parse-CSV-Flow
sub-flow.description: Parses the incoming CSV payload into an array of records. Uses Mule's DataWeave CSV parsing capabilities. Fields are dynamically detected from the CSV header row.

sub-flow.name: Validate-CSV-Records-Flow
sub-flow.description: Validates CSV records for mandatory fields and basic integrity. Splits into valid and rejected records.

sub-flow.name: Apply-Business-Rules-Batch-Flow
sub-flow.description: Applies all configured business rules to each valid record. Processes records in parallel using a foreach or scatter-gather pattern.

sub-flow.name: Transform-To-SKY-Payload-Flow
sub-flow.description: Transforms validated and enriched CSV records into the SKY API journal entry batch payload structure using DataWeave.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from csv-to-journal output application/json --- var batchConfig = { description: "Salesforce GL Import - " ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}), postDate: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}, sourceSystemName: "Salesforce", journalEntryBatchType: "Standard" } --- transformToJournalEntryBatch(payload, batchConfig)

sub-flow.name: Generate-Processing-Summary
sub-flow.description: Generates a processing summary response with status counts.
